title: The Lost City That Vanished Under Sand
title_full: The Lost City That Vanished Under Sand #Shorts #facts #didyouknow #lostcivilizations
description:
What else is buried?

Zerzura, the legendary 'Oasis of Little Birds,' captivated explorers for centuries. Was it a real lost city, or just a desert mirage? Dive into the mystery of this phantom city swallowed by legend, not sand. Follow for more!
